_comment: Perf baseline — generated 2026-06-12 on linux-x64. Ratchet rule: budgets set at ceil(measured_max × 2) for startup, and at the stated SLO for frame timing (p95 ≤ 16ms). Regenerate with: bun run perf:baseline

renderer_load_ms.note: Time to cold-import compositor + buffer + grid from a fresh bun process. Budget = ceil(max × 2), rounded to 50ms. Ratchet: tighten budget when measured_max drops below budget/2.

composite_p95_ms.note: Compositor.composite() p95 over 200 full-repaint frames, 80×24 synthetic content. Budget = stated frame SLO (16ms). Ratchet: tighten when measured drops below budget/3.

composite_p99_ms.note: Compositor.composite() p99 over 200 frames. Budget = ceil(measured × 4), rounded to 10ms. Ratchet: tighten when measured drops below budget/3.
